classification.difficultyReason: Interpret each arrow as a fraction of its full dimension and combine the two fractions into the multiplication represented by the shaded intersection.

spec.description: Two equal columns and seven equal rows, with the upper-left cell shaded. Unlabelled horizontal and vertical double-headed arrows span the left column and top row respectively.
spec.mathematics: The shaded intersection represents one seventh of one half.
spec.answerVisibility: The grid, shading and arrows are supplied; fractional labels and multiplication expression are withheld.

answer.worked: The vertical arrow spans $1$ of the $7$ equal rows; the horizontal arrow spans $1$ of the $2$ equal columns. The model represents $\frac{1}{7}\times\frac{1}{2}$.

spec.description: Two equal columns and seven equal rows, with the top five cells in the left column shaded. Unlabelled horizontal and vertical double-headed arrows span the left column and top five rows respectively.
spec.mathematics: The shaded intersection represents five sevenths of one half.

answer.worked: The vertical arrow spans $5$ of the $7$ equal rows; the horizontal arrow spans $1$ of the $2$ equal columns. The model represents $\frac{5}{7}\times\frac{1}{2}$.
